title: Lesson 2 Checkpoint — Subject Pronouns
description: Show what you learned about subject pronouns. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.
canDo: I can use subject pronouns correctly in simple sentences.

questions.question: Marco is from Italy. Which pronoun replaces Marco?
questions.explanation: Marco is a male person → subject pronoun he.

questions.question: Complete with a subject pronoun: ___ am Laura. I am from Argentina.
questions.explanation: The speaker talks about herself → I (+ am).

questions.question: True or false: "They are a small group." can refer to Laura and her classmates.
Ms. Lee is the teacher. Which pronoun replaces Ms. Lee?
questions.explanation: Ms. Lee is a female person → she.

questions.question: Match the person/thing with the correct subject pronoun.
questions.explanation: Replace the noun with the pronoun that fits number and gender.
